purpose: Contract fixtures for preserving facts and output shape; they are not provider-backed quality evidence.

cases.prompt: 请润色中文结果段，保留统计信息。
cases.input: 值得注意的是，本研究通过三组独立实验进行了评估，结果显示该方法具有显著效果（p<0.01）。
cases.polished_fixture: 本研究通过三组独立实验评估该方法；结果显示其效果显著（p<0.01）。
cases.human_notes: The fixture retains the experiment count and does not turn statistical significance into an effect-size claim. Read the source before deleting any method detail.

cases.prompt: Polish this English Methods sentence and keep the citation.
cases.input: The evaluation of model performance was conducted through the utilization of five-fold cross-validation [12].
cases.polished_fixture: Model performance was evaluated with five-fold cross-validation [12].
cases.human_notes: The fixture demonstrates a minimal edit; venue-specific style still outranks this default.

cases.prompt: Polish without changing values, units, or identifiers.
cases.input: The cohort included 1,204 participants; the hazard ratio was 0.82 (95% CI, 0.78–0.87; p<0.001) for MASLD.
cases.polished_fixture: The cohort included 1,204 participants; the hazard ratio for MASLD was 0.82 (95% CI, 0.78–0.87; p < 0.001).
assertions: all numbers and range values are preserved
cases.human_notes: The preservation script normalizes spacing around the p-value operator but remains only a surface alarm.

cases.prompt: 把 NSFC 立项依据改得更凝练，不补充前期数据。
cases.input: 本项目具有重要的理论意义和现实意义，有望为相关研究提供新的思路。
cases.polished_fixture: 本项目具有重要的理论和现实意义，有望为相关研究提供新的思路。[待核实：原文未说明具体科学问题、证据缺口或可检验目标]
cases.human_notes: A language pass cannot supply the missing scientific question; ask for those inputs before drafting a stronger claim.
